title: Alaska News Nightly: Friday, September 18, 2026
text:
Friday on Alaska News Nightly

Anchorage students deal with crowded classrooms, and the Alaska Senate president prepares to retire from the Legislature.

Also, a Ketchikan business aims to get Alaska oysters national recognition.

Reports tonight from:

Hannah Flor and Ava White in Anchorage,Tim Ellis in Delta Junction,Clarise Larson in Juneau,Davis Hovey in Kodiak,Baiz Hoen in Petersburg,Sofia Stuart-Rasi in Unalaska,and Sydney Dauphinais in Ketchikan.

This episode of Alaska News Nightly is hosted by Casey Grove with audio engineering from Crystal Hyde and production by Patrick Gilchrist.
